_readme: EPISODES — podcast / video segments related to the stormwater plan and specific districts (e.g., 'AI for Good: Transforming Communities' civic segments). This file is an ARRAY; the first element is this metadata object, remaining elements are episode rows. Row schema: {title, date (ISO8601 date), districtSlug (must match a real district route slug or '' for site-wide), topic, mediaUrl}. Placeholder rows below are clearly labeled — replace mediaUrl with the real published link before promoting. TO EDIT: GitHub → PR → Vercel Preview → merge. No per-property dollar figures.
